title: Corrected evidence-type bridge: trace vs scalar verified selective computation
question: At fixed terminal candidate budget B=8, does a target-blind activation-trace probe convert its measured information advantage into higher exact downstream verification success than the best scalar-output probe, when both arms extract candidate and target evidence through one identical typed path?
hypothesis: With a single typed evidence-extraction path in both arms, the activation-trace channel will produce substantially higher verified selective-computation success at M=512/B=8 than scalar output because its one-step evidence partitions leave far fewer compatible hypotheses.

arms.name: scalar_row
arms.intervention: choose one input row by deterministic maximum-information-per-environment-work selection; observe only the binary output

arms.name: activation_trace
arms.intervention: choose one input row by the same deterministic selector over ordered non-input activation bits; observe the full six-bit activation trace

endpoints.name: verified_success_delta_m512_b8
endpoints.role: primary — seed-level activation_trace minus scalar_row exact-verifier success difference at M=512/B=8

endpoints.name: verified_success
endpoints.role: secondary — exact verifier success across B=1/2/4/8 and all registered M levels

endpoints.name: target_bucket_size
endpoints.role: secondary — compatible candidates after the selected probe

endpoints.name: information_gain_bits
endpoints.role: secondary — one-step deterministic information under the selected channel

endpoints.name: expected_remaining_candidates
endpoints.role: secondary — collision expectation after the selected probe

endpoints.name: execution_work_fraction
endpoints.role: secondary — terminal verification work divided by exhaustive exact verification work

endpoints.name: budget_capped_utility
endpoints.role: secondary — partition-implied expected terminal success U_B for the selected evidence channel under a uniform target prior

endpoints.name: accounted_total_work_units
endpoints.role: secondary — probe plus terminal verification work

endpoints.name: success_per_accounted_work
endpoints.role: secondary — verified success divided by explicitly accounted total work

endpoints.name: total_operations
endpoints.role: secondary — sum of signature construction, candidate scan, probe selection and terminal verification operations; the full computational cost of one selective pass

endpoints.name: verified_success_per_total_operations
endpoints.role: secondary — verified success divided by total operations; capability per unit of total computation, not per unit of execution work alone

endpoints.name: candidate_scan_operations
endpoints.role: secondary — candidate evidence reads required to build the probe-selection signatures, O(M x rows), which the prior accounting omitted

endpoints.name: verifier_work_units
endpoints.role: secondary — terminal exact verification work over the shortlist only

held_constant: same static 512-program evaluation library per seed

terminal_protocol.procedure: After selecting one probe without target identity, form the exact compatible evidence bucket from the realized target evidence, retain the first min(8,bucket_size) candidates in deterministic public library order, and run exact CASM verification against all 16 input rows.

cost_model.probe_environment: same G-CASM-015 exact graph execution plus trace read units
cost_model.terminal_verification: sum of exact executor work over shortlisted candidates and all 16 rows
cost_model.exhaustive_reference: same exact executor work over all M candidates and all 16 rows

comparison_axes.equal_environment_execution_count: Both arms acquire exactly one graph execution before observation; activation_trace additionally incurs six trace-read units.
comparison_axes.explicit_work: Report graph execution work, trace-read work, terminal verifier work, and their sum in the repository's discrete work units.
comparison_axes.interpretation: Primary capability comparison fixes one probe action per task; total-work metrics are secondary because trace reads and graph execution use different primitive accounting.
comparison_axes.total_operations: Probe work is recorded as a total over candidates (per-candidate mean x M), not the per-candidate mean alone, so the recorded accounting scales with the real O(M) acquisition scan. Per-candidate mean is retained as a separate endpoint for comparability with G-CASM-015.

work_operation_terms.signature_construction_operations: candidate evidence reads used to build selection signatures
work_operation_terms.candidate_scan_operations: candidate evidence reads across probe rows
work_operation_terms.execution_operations: exact graph execution work inside terminal verification
work_operation_terms.verification_operations: terminal exact verification work over the shortlist

leakage_rules: Probe selection uses only public candidate-predicted evidence and public action descriptors.
Target identity and target index are never supplied to selection.
Realized target evidence is unavailable until after the action is selected.
Exact verifier rows are not available to the selector.
No result from 016C is used to alter probe definitions or the terminal budget.

decision_rule.condition: Primary activation_trace minus scalar_row CI is positive and excludes zero at M=512/B=8.
decision_rule.licenses: evidence that structured execution evidence translates into higher verified selective-computation capability on the finite registered workload.
decision_rule.does_not_license: learned probe policy, asymptotic scaling, arbitrary internal-state access, or multimodal competence.

decision_rule.condition: Trace increases information but not verified success.
decision_rule.licenses: the observation channel is informative but downstream evidence-to-action translation remains limiting.

decision_rule.condition: Trace and scalar verified success are similar.
decision_rule.licenses: the measured information advantage does not automatically translate into terminal capability under B=8.
decision_rule.does_not_license: failure of other structured evidence channels.

predicted_budget_capped_ceiling.definition: U_B = sum_e min(B, |H_e|) / M for the selected activation-trace partition, averaged over the five registered seeds
predicted_budget_capped_ceiling.interpretation: This is the exact partition-implied ceiling for the registered target-uniform terminal shortlist procedure on the frozen 015 libraries, not a measured 016C outcome.
predicted_budget_capped_ceiling.note: Equal one-probe-count comparison and explicit-work accounting are both reported; the primary endpoint is capability at a fixed one-probe budget, not a claim that the trace is equal-cost.

correction.reason: R1's scalar arm compared int candidate evidence to a 1-tuple target, so int == (int,) was always False and every scalar compatible bucket was deterministically empty (target_bucket_size = 0 in all 800 scalar trials, scalar verified_success = 0.0 at every M). The recorded mean_paired_delta 0.83125 is therefore a comparison against a structurally absent arm, not a measured channel difference.
protocol_changes: Candidate and target evidence are now extracted through one typed function per channel, so the two arms cannot diverge in shape.

A runner-level invariant is enforced on every generated trial: candidate and target evidence must have identical type, and the compatible bucket must be non-empty because the target is itself a candidate. This replaces R1's regression, which asserted type identity only on a hand-written literal and so passed while the runner was broken.

Probe work is recorded as a total over candidates rather than a per-candidate mean, and per-trial operation counters are added for signature construction, candidate scan, probe selection, execution and verification.
correction.required_regression: For every generated trial and both channels: type(candidate_evidence[i]) == type(target_evidence) and |{i : candidate_evidence[i] == target_evidence}| >= 1. Checked by the runner, which fails closed; also asserted by an offline test against the real generator.

invalidates.reason: identical type mismatch; R1 diff to 016C was an identifier rename only
